prompt: Make me a grocery list app with quantities in my personal space. Use create_app with slug "eval-grocery-quantities" and the closest template, edit the source if it isn't already a shopping list with quantities, then call build_app until it succeeds. Don't ask questions — just build it.

Make me a habit tracker in my personal space. Use create_app with slug "eval-habit-tracker" and the closest template, edit if needed so I can add habits and check them off each day, then build_app until it succeeds. Don't ask questions — just build it.

Make me a notes app in my personal space: each note has a title and a body. Use create_app with slug "eval-notes" and the closest template, edit if needed, then build_app until it succeeds. Don't ask questions — just build it.

Make me a todo list / checklist app in my personal space. Use create_app with slug "eval-todo-list" and the closest template, edit if needed so I can add items and tick them off, then build_app until it succeeds. Don't ask questions — just build it.

Make me a shopping list app in my personal space. Use create_app with slug "eval-shopping-list" and the closest template, edit if needed, then build_app until it succeeds. Don't ask questions — just build it.

Make me a chore chart app in my personal space: a list of chores we can tick off. Use create_app with slug "eval-chore-chart" and the closest template, edit if needed, then build_app until it succeeds. Don't ask questions — just build it.

Make me a packing list app in my personal space for a trip: add things to pack and mark them packed. Use create_app with slug "eval-packing-list" and the closest template, edit if needed, then build_app until it succeeds. Don't ask questions — just build it.

Make me a recipe notebook in my personal space: each recipe has a title and the recipe text. Use create_app with slug "eval-recipe-notebook" and the closest template, edit if needed, then build_app until it succeeds. Don't ask questions — just build it.

Make me a reading list app in my personal space: books I want to read, with a way to mark them read. Use create_app with slug "eval-reading-list" and the closest template, edit if needed, then build_app until it succeeds. Don't ask questions — just build it.

Make me a daily water / habit tracker in my personal space: add a habit and check it in each day. Use create_app with slug "eval-water-tracker" and the closest template, edit if needed, then build_app until it succeeds. Don't ask questions — just build it.
Add a brand to pantry items so I can note which brand I bought. Put it on the add form and the item screen, and show it in the list. Rebuild it when you're done, and don't ask me questions.
Add a nickname for each person. Show it on their screen and next to their name in the list. Rebuild it when you're done, and don't ask me questions.
Add a Records screen that lists my heaviest set for each exercise, with a button on the Exercises tab that opens it. Rebuild it when you're done, and don't ask me questions.
Add a screen that lists only the recipes that take 30 minutes or less, opened from a button on the Recipes tab. Rebuild it when you're done, and don't ask me questions.
On each habit's screen, add a bar chart of how many check-ins it had each week for the last 8 weeks. Rebuild it when you're done, and don't ask me questions.
On the History tab, add a bar chart of how many chores were done each week for the last 8 weeks. Rebuild it when you're done, and don't ask me questions.
